changelog: Say "undo the rewrite" — or "আগের লেখাটা ফেরাও" in Bengali — alone while dictating in WhatsApp or Messenger and the last AI rewrite (fix it, formalize, shorten, elaborate, friendly, emojify, rephrase or translate) is undone: the message comes back exactly as you dictated it. The safety net for all eight rewrites — until now a rewrite you did not like could only be fixed by re-dictating. If you typed or dictated on since the rewrite, it refuses instead of touching your text.
